messages:
marta: Trying the Python quickstart; my first API call is a 403 and the body says {"error":"workspace_provisioning_required","detail":"enable_billing"}. New hire invite. Any tips?
lee: Hi @marta, did you create the workspace or join via invite? Also share the quickstart command you ran (token redacted).
marta: Joined via invite. curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}'
sam: Sounds like the invite-created workspace has no billing attached. We recently introduced a provisioning state that can block API access.
lee: Quick workaround: create a personal sandbox from Console > Create workspace. That workspace gets trial credits and you can set env var RW_WORKSPACE to it for the quickstart.
marta: Created sandbox, set RW_WORKSPACE, now I get streaming tokens and a 200. First successful call! :tada:
sam: Filing DE-901 to make the console show a clearer billing CTA for invite flows and to standardize the API error to billing_required.
ops-bot: [ticket created] DE-901 created and assigned to sam.
marta: Thanks all, saved my afternoon. Will wait for owner to add payment method for main org.
